rows.name: Payment receipt
rows.subject: Transfer receipt
rows.body: Your transfer of NGN 12500 to Sample Merchant was successful. Reference DEMO001. No action is required. Thank you for banking with us.

rows.name: Credit alert
rows.subject: Credit transaction
rows.body: Your account ending 0000 has been credited with NGN 25000. This notification is for your records only. Please check your mobile banking app for details.

rows.name: Debit alert
rows.subject: Debit transaction
rows.body: A debit of NGN 3500 was recorded on your account ending 0000 for a supermarket purchase. Keep this notice for your records.

rows.name: Monthly statement
rows.subject: Your monthly statement
rows.body: Your monthly account statement is available in your banking app. Open the app as usual to view your transactions. There is no need to reply to this message.

rows.name: OTP notification
rows.subject: Your verification code
rows.body: Your one-time verification code is 123456. It expires in five minutes. Do not share this code with anyone. If you did not initiate this request, contact your bank.

rows.name: Anti-fraud warning
rows.subject: Protect your account
rows.body: Never share your password, PIN or OTP with anyone. Your bank will never ask you to disclose these details. Contact your bank through its official channels if you suspect fraud.

rows.name: Password-change notice
rows.subject: Password updated
rows.body: Your online banking password was changed successfully. If you made this change, no action is required. Otherwise contact customer support through your banking app.

rows.name: Maintenance notice
rows.subject: Scheduled service maintenance
rows.body: Our banking services will be temporarily unavailable between midnight and two tomorrow morning while we perform maintenance. Thank you for your patience.

rows.name: KYC branch notice
rows.subject: Update your customer information
rows.body: Please visit any of our branches with a valid identity document to update your customer information. Do not send identification documents, passwords or verification codes by email.

rows.name: Support education
rows.subject: Recognising phishing
rows.body: Fraudsters may write: send your password and OTP immediately. This is a phishing attempt. Never follow such instructions or disclose your banking credentials.

rows.name: Ordinary meeting
rows.subject: Project meeting
rows.body: Please join our scheduled team meeting tomorrow morning to discuss the project report and update our work plans.

rows.name: Research invitation
rows.subject: Seminar invitation
rows.body: You are invited to attend our cybersecurity seminar next Friday at the university. The event will discuss banking fraud prevention and safe online practices.

rows.name: Urgent password and OTP
rows.subject: Account suspension notice
rows.body: Your Access Bank account will be suspended today. Reply with your password, PIN and OTP immediately to prevent account closure.

rows.name: BVN link lure
rows.subject: BVN validation required
rows.body: Dear customer, your BVN has not been validated. Visit https://access-verify.invalid/login and enter your online banking password and OTP to restore access.

rows.name: Polite OTP request
rows.subject: Assistance with your account
rows.body: Hello, I am helping with your account update. Please send me the one-time code you just received so I can complete the process for you.

rows.name: Refund password lure
rows.subject: Your refund is ready
rows.body: A refund has been approved for your account. Confirm your online banking username and password at https://refund.invalid/claim to receive the payment.

rows.name: Card details lure
rows.subject: Card renewal
rows.body: To renew your debit card, reply with the full card number, expiry date, CVV and your card PIN. Our agent will process the renewal today.

rows.name: Safe wording then attack
rows.subject: Account security advice
rows.body: We care about your security. Never share your PIN with strangers. To protect this account, enter your password and OTP at https://bank-review.invalid/verify now.

rows.name: No urgency password request
rows.subject: Routine reconciliation
rows.body: For routine account reconciliation, please provide your online banking username and password in a reply to this email.

rows.name: GTBank verification
rows.subject: GTBank customer review
rows.body: Your GTBank profile needs a review. Sign in at https://gtb-review.invalid and provide your password and current token code to complete verification.

rows.name: Zenith credential request
rows.subject: Zenith account update
rows.body: Your Zenith account has been restricted. Send your login password and OTP to this email address so our support team can reactivate it.

rows.name: UBA account lure
rows.subject: UBA account confirmation
rows.body: Confirm your UBA login at https://uba-confirm.invalid. Enter your username, password and SMS verification code to avoid losing access.

rows.name: Informal Nigerian wording
rows.subject: Abeg send the code
rows.body: Good afternoon boss, na your bank support. Abeg send the OTP wey enter your phone make we finish this account verification for you.

rows.name: Long polite lure
rows.subject: Customer service follow-up
rows.body: Thank you for your patience while we reviewed your request. We appreciate your continued relationship with our bank and apologise for the delay. To complete this review, kindly reply with your account password and the one-time verification code sent to your phone. Our team will then confirm that your records have been updated.
